time_convention: All times UTC. Duty windows use calendar days (UTC dates), inclusive of the duty date.

definitions.duty_period: report_utc to release_utc. Report = first departure minus 60 min; release = last arrival plus 30 min.
definitions.fdp: Flight Duty Period = duty period length in hours.
definitions.reserve_callout: A reserve may be called out only if the callout time falls inside their on-call window. Once assigned, they operate as line crew (window no longer applies).

rules.text: Max flight duty period 13h, reduced 0.5h per sector beyond the 2nd.
Max 60 duty hours in any 7 consecutive calendar days (inclusive of duty date).
Max 100 flight (block) hours in any 28 consecutive calendar days.
Min 12h rest between release and next report.
Crew must hold a valid rating for the assigned aircraft type.
All certifications must be valid on the duty date.
Reserve callout from own base only; covering from another base requires deadhead positioning (cost applies).
